scope: Source representation audit and correction only; no motion scoring.
trigger: The source image inverse treats surface pixels as constant cells, while the field loader linearly interpolates node values. Audit that basis change against the measured projected image.
representation: Nonnegative bilinear planar node values times the declared continuous vertical exponential mixture. Finite image cells integrate the projection of that same bilinear basis.
thin_image_matrix: Center weight 3/4 and nearest-neighbor weights 1/8, without renormalizing boundary flux loss.
vertical_projected_matrix: Convolution of the vertical Laplace kernel, the triangular linear-node basis and the finite image top-hat; exact central/neighbor coefficients and exponential tail.
source_weights_support_regularization: Inherited unchanged from previous_source_protocol. Source fitting is permitted; response data remain unopened by this package.
